original_test_intent: Validate PCIe Gen5 Advanced Error Reporting behavior for the specified NVIDIA path using the authoritative vendor mode, including expected detection, attribution, severity, logging and recovery while leaving the SUT usable.
original_method: First decide whether coverage is passive observation, vendor-contained injection or separate checkpoints; pin NVDiag/config and topology; capture AER capability/masks/severity/counters/log baseline; for any injection approve exact bounded error class/location/count and recovery; run once under OOB/watchdog, correlate FCT with kernel/BMC/endpoint/upstream records, prove stimulus removal/recovery and preserve all events.
manual_activity: PCIe/reliability owner selects observation or bounded injection semantics, approves error classes/targets/expected recovery and OOB plan and owns verdict.
required_inputs: Decision on passive observation versus injection or separate variants
Signed pinned NVDiag AER artifact/config and vendor mode guide
Stable endpoint/upstream/retimer topology and AER capability map
Expected error class/severity/location/count/log/recovery matrix and SKU exception
Isolated window, watchdog, console/OOB, abort and recovery procedure
safety_requirements: No injection until exact class/target/count/recovery is approved
Preserve all existing AER/dmesg/SEL counters and logs
Bound stimulus and monitor kernel/link/GPU/BMC/OOB health independently
Abort on escalation beyond approved class, reset loop, panic or management loss
Prove stimulus removed and recovery completed; never auto-retry or clear events
agent_execution_scope: Await mode decision and validate artifact/topology/oracle/recovery gates
Run only approved passive or bounded vendor mode once
Correlate detection/recovery and report without DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Select observation/injection coverage and error matrix
Approve bounded stimulus, exception and recovery

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Generic module instruction omits whether errors are injected and how handling is evaluated.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: No AER FCT is executable until mode is approved; then run only pinned vendor `pcie_gen5_aer` configuration for the confirmed path with bounded documented semantics and full unfiltered evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: AER purpose and ten/twenty-minute estimates remain; no error class or stimulus is inferred.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a stimulus/observation ledger binding each approved error to source BDF/path, expected severity/counter/log/action and observed kernel/BMC/device recovery, with pre/post masks/counters.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes a potentially hazardous fault test explicit and bounded instead of accepting an opaque pass string.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Absence of AER events during a generic diagnostic does not validate injection/detection/recovery behavior.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Fatal or uncorrectable injection may exceed software recovery and require physical/OOB intervention; such classes cannot be assumed in scope.

project_override_considerations: Reliability owner defines safe error classes and whether destructive/fatal stimulus is prohibited or belongs in a separately controlled manual variant.
expected_evidence: Approved AER mode/error/recovery decision and NVDiag artifact hashes
Stable topology plus pre capability/mask/severity/counter/log baseline
Exact bounded stimulus or observation configuration, target, class, count and timestamps
Stimulus removal, counter deltas and documented device/link/OS recovery/usability

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row255 Wistron-NV GPU-00248-V002: decide whether NVDiag AER coverage is passive observation, bounded vendor fault injection, or separate variants; approve exact target/path, correctable/non-fatal/fatal classes, count, masks/severity, expected kernel/BMC handling, counter/log changes, SkuCheck exception and OOB recovery. No fault is to be invented or injected meanwhile.

review_improvement: Prevents opaque AER FCT execution until hazardous stimulus and expected recovery are explicitly bounded and traceable.
independent_technical_reasoning: AER validation can mean merely reading capability/status or actively injecting correctable, non-fatal or fatal faults; these have radically different blast radii and acceptance evidence. Clearing counters destroys causality, while preexisting events require a baseline. A tool PASS cannot show the kernel logged the correct source/severity or that recovery restored the device. Therefore operation mode and error matrix require explicit owner approval before execution.
